2608.03902.title: When Efficiency Becomes Fragility: Exploiting Dynamic Routing Vulnerabilities in Adaptive UAV Tracking
2608.03902.paper_summary: Resource constraints on UAV platforms have driven a paradigm shift in aerial tracking, from pursuing performance toward balancing accuracy with efficiency. Adaptive Transformer Trackers, which leverage an input-dependent dynamic routing architecture, have emerged as a representative solution to this challenge. However, we reveal that behind this computation-on-demand flexibility hides a critical structural flaw: the Lipschitz singularity of computational path decisions, which has an unbounded local Lipschitz constant at discrete layer-skipping decision boundaries. This mathematical discontinuity renders adaptive tracking networks inherently unstable: tiny input perturbations can be amplified at the gating modules, causing dramatic changes in the inference topology. We formally characterize this singularity in the context of adaptive tracking architectures and, for the first time, identify it as a directly exploitable new attack surface. This insight reveals a previously overlooked and highly vulnerable topological path space attack surface. Based on this, we propose the Adversarial Path-Inversion (API) framework. API generates imperceptible perturbations to precisely manipulate the gating decisions, forcing the inference onto altered computational paths. The severe inconsistency between the original and the inverted paths dismantles the representation capability of the model. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art adaptive trackers demonstrate that API achieves superior perturbation stealthiness, more effective attack, and faster inference speeds. This work opens a new dimension for the security analysis of dynamic tracking networks and provides a theoretical warning for constructing robust adaptive tracking architectures in the future.
2608.03902.paper_summary_zh: 資源限制對無人機平台的影響促使了空中追蹤的範式轉變，從追求性能轉向平衡準確性與效率。自適應Transformer追蹤器利用依賴於輸入的動態路由架構，已成為應對這一挑戰的代表性解決方案。然而，我們揭示了這種按需計算的靈活性背後隱藏著一個關鍵的結構缺陷：計算路徑決策的Lipschitz奇異性，在離散層跳過決策邊界處具有無界的局部Lipschitz常數。這一數學不連續性使得自適應追蹤網絡本質上不穩定：微小的輸入擾動可以在閘模塊中被放大，導致推理拓撲的劇烈變化。我們在自適應追蹤架構的背景下正式描述了這一奇異性，並首次將其識別為一個可以直接利用的新攻擊面。這一洞察揭示了一個先前被忽視且高度脆弱的拓撲路徑空間攻擊面。基於此，我們提出了對抗性路徑反轉（API）框架。API生成不可察覺的擾動，以精確操控閘決策，迫使推理進入改變的計算路徑。原始路徑與反轉路徑之間的嚴重不一致性破壞了模型的表徵能力。對最先進的自適應追蹤器進行的廣泛實驗表明，API實現了更優越的擾動隱蔽性、更有效的攻擊和更快的推理速度。這項工作為動態追蹤網絡的安全分析開辟了新維度，並為未來構建穩健的自適應追蹤架構提供了理論警示。
